title: 3D Printer Factory Tour plus 2 ft Tall Rocket!
includes: A 2 ft. tall Gigabot 3D printed rocket (one per group of 15)!
A hands-on guided tour of our factory, with photo ops!
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Location contains friendly dogs and goats!
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
re:3D is a fully open source, collaborative company with a social mission focused on breaking through the limits of 3D printing and creating actionable solutions to recycling plastics.

At our Austin HQ, you will learn how 3D printing works, see how large-format 3D printers get made, touch and feel 3D prints from around the world and learn from experts in additive manufacturing.

To book a tour, please select your preferred day and time between 9:30 AM and 4:00 PM and we will do our best to accommodate you. We are also willing to accommodate groups larger than fifteen people. Please feel free to reach out to us at discover@re3D.org with any questions you might have!
